CustomField.label: Key
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically by the load script as <Opportunity Id>-<Campaign Id>. Do not edit.
CustomField.description: Salesforce has no composite unique constraint, so this external id stands in for one. The load script upserts on Key__c, which makes tagging idempotent: re-running it updates rather than creating a second identical tag. Unique also stops a duplicate being created by hand.
